newsitem.title: USA: H.J. Heinz acquires Martin Feed business.
newsitem.headline: H.J. Heinz acquires Martin Feed business.

text.p: H.J. Heinz Co said Wednesday its Canadian affiliate, H.J. Heinz Co of Canada Ltd, had completed the acquisition of "substantially all" of the pet food businesses of Martin Feed Mills Ltd of Elmira, Ontario.
"As a result of this acquisition, Heinz Canada now has more than $74 million ... in annual pet food sales," it said.
Heinz did not reveal the details of the deal.
Martin produces and markets cat and dog food throughout Canada as well as exports to Japan and Europe.
Martin sells pet food under the Techni-Cal brand and markets products under the Medi-Cal label through veterinary offices and clinics.
